author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000193023 L-proline catabolic process to L-glutamate, L-glutamate gamma-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
PTN000193024 mitochondrion
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
CG6661 D. melanogaster (Q95TY8)
* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation
CG6661 (Q95TY8) has only one (E) of the 2 active sites (E and C) conserved and the NAD+ binidng sites are not conserved suggesting that it lacks L-glutamate gamma-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity and is probably not involved in proline biosynthesis.
title: PTN000193023 and PTN000193024 for Dmel CG6661
